//: CDDA experimental builds only.  There, riot damage is applied by the post-process generator "riot_damage", which the apartment tower base terrain (abstract apartments_tower_any) carries; this deletes it for the twelve interior levels so windows and furniture stay intact.  It is the same mechanism upstream uses itself - see generic_city_house_roof in data/json/overmap/overmap_terrain/overmap_terrain_residential.json.  Home Start's own patch (which removes the old PP_GENERATE_RIOT_DAMAGE flag) stays active and is harmless on experimental builds.
